sentences.en: They all represent the obsessional, neurotic and fetishistic sexuality of a gay scene, created by and for white men.

sentences.en: Indeed, there may be a fetishistic interest in misshapen or even missing body parts –a hump, a goiter, or an amputation.

sentences.en: In Japan the fetishistic love for two-dimensional characters is enough of a phenomenon to have earned its own slang word, moe, homonymous with the Japanese words for "burning" or "budding."

sentences.en: OK, I know I am a little bit fetishistic. I wouldn't take it seriously if it is told by friends or families.
